# robinhood-volume-alerts

> Telegram alert bot for Robinhood Chain (EVM chain id 4663). Watches every DEX trade on the chain via the public RPC, learns each token's normal per-minute volume, and alerts on volume spikes, whale trades, price moves, liquidity pulls (rug warnings), new launches, graduations, and watched-wallet trades. Tracks the performance of its own calls (2x/5x/10x follow-ups and a scorecard). One Node.js process, one SQLite file, no API keys.

Install: `npm install -g robinhood-volume-alerts`. Binaries: `robinhood-volume-alerts` and `hood-alerts`. Commands: `start`, `dry-run` (live pipeline, console only, no Telegram token needed), `doctor` (checks RPC, chain id, log-scan support, database, Telegram token, channel post permission), `version`. Configuration is environment based; `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` is the only required variable. Library entry point: `startApp()` from the package root.

Live instance: t.me/hoodcryptochainbot with the public feed at t.me/hoodchains.
